productDestination: VM103 Core Appliance with a separate private SGLang plane

computerUse.reason: Visible Chrome remained unavailable. Arc completed the real Keycloak login and exposed the Application-creation elevation defect without changing browser security settings. Brave reproduced a Keycloak restart-cookie compatibility failure under its default protections.

findings.reproduction: Open the authenticated Console at a 1024 by 768 desktop viewport.
findings.expected: The fixed navigation and 640-pixel Console content remain inside the viewport without horizontal scrolling or clipped controls.
findings.actual: The shell extends 150 pixels past the viewport and clips page actions and controls.
findings.evidence: Playwright measured document overflow and clipped controls in credential-free screenshots for both roles.
findings.resolution: F0-UX3 uses a bounded responsive Console content width and enforces the 1024-pixel desktop boundary in the real-browser suite; admitted through protected PR 76.

findings.reproduction: Sign in as Admin and open Team.
findings.expected: The v1 Team overview offers approved basic user administration only.
findings.actual: The overview advertises deferred CSV import and arbitrary group creation.
findings.evidence: Credential-free Admin Team screenshot and accessible-role inspection.
findings.resolution: F0-UX3 removes both deferred actions from the Team overview while retaining approved basic user administration; admitted through protected PR 76.

findings.reproduction: Start the keep-running F0-UAT0 environment from clean temporary state and open Overview.
findings.expected: A clean founder environment reports the actual healthy baseline unless a supported alert is active.
findings.actual: The UAT fixture posts an alert outside the Product allowlist, so the Product correctly omits it and reports Degraded and Needs attention.
findings.evidence: Overview and Hardware screenshots plus source trace from the UAT alert fixture to the strict Alertmanager allowlist.
findings.resolution: F0-UAT1 skips the disposable synthetic alert only in keep-running founder mode, projects private Grafana health into Settings, and adds browser assertions for healthy Hardware and System state.

findings.reproduction: Inspect visible interactive bounds in the authenticated Console.
findings.expected: Frequently used targets should be comfortably operable at desktop sizes.
findings.actual: Several targets are 20 to 32 pixels high. Focus-visible styling, form labels, accessible names, heading structure, and keyboard shortcuts are present.
findings.evidence: Playwright geometry and source-level focus-style inspection.
findings.resolution: Recorded as non-blocking final polish; no focus, label, naming, heading, or keyboard-access defect was demonstrated.

findings.reproduction: Start the keep-running founder environment and inspect the CPU utilization signal after Prometheus has collected the deterministic metrics fixture.
findings.expected: The healthy founder fixture reports a utilization value consistent with the displayed warning and critical thresholds.
findings.actual: A static idle counter yields a zero idle rate, so the Console correctly derives 100 percent utilization while the fixture has no corresponding alert.
findings.evidence: Protected-final Playwright Hardware inspection at commit c89a018a67f745e8310404de045e239a9a077f00.
findings.resolution: F0-UAT2 uses two private deterministic idle-counter series, one clock-backed and one constant, to produce a stable 50 percent utilization signal without changing Product queries or alert policy.

findings.reproduction: Open Add app without a fresh elevation, complete the form, and submit Create app in visible Arc.
findings.expected: High-risk verification occurs before data entry, then returns the Admin to the empty creation form with a fresh elevation window.
findings.actual: Verification begins only after submission, returns to the Applications list, and discards the completed form, forcing duplicate entry. A later invalid submission also clears the form.
findings.evidence: Visible Arc Computer Use against VM117 from protected integration c89a018a67f745e8310404de045e239a9a077f00.
findings.resolution: F0-UX4 gates the Add app route before rendering the form, returns verified Admins to /applications/apps/new, retains the server-action capability check as defense in depth, and updates the browser harness to reject post-entry elevation.

falsePositives.observation: Grafana name appears in Hardware, Activity and Settings.
